owner_statement: Can you stop making me have to do this? Like, you should just be able to authorize this. I give you authority to do all future authorizations.
campaign_goal: Continue the existing bidirectional pawn-push campaign to one honest admitted REAL_TO_SIM case and one distinct admitted SIM_TO_REAL case.
delegated_actions: approve evaluator and V06 transitions after all predecessor gates pass
approve counted-action freezes after all predecessor gates pass
approve physical test packets only after every existing proof and safety gate passes
issue manager authorization receipts without further owner prompts
continue after each receipt-backed negative with the smallest mechanism-specific successor supported by static or evaluator evidence
nondelegable_boundaries: robot motion outside a prospectively reviewed physical packet
weakening safety, start-envelope, torque, camera, serial, gateway, or abort gates
brev_policy: Brev remains empty unless separately explicitly authorized.

initial_successor.mechanism: alternate robot start posture, deterministic multi-start IK branch, and minimal approach-azimuth or lateral-clearance waypoint family
design_sources: modeled jaw and arm collision geometry

claim_boundary: Standing campaign delegation for in-scope prospective authorization decisions. It does not itself authorize model loading, simulation, V06, counted action compilation, camera, gateway, serial, physical motion, simulator promotion, or a transfer claim; each still requires its own prospective contract and every predecessor gate.
